plan.headline: 6 dates in Appalachia and the Ohio Valley, where her fans already are
plan.summary: This is a tight loop out of Nashville through the strongest unplayed metros on Sierra's heatmap. Every stop scores 0.974 affinity or higher, and no leg is longer than 4.4 hours. Asheville (0.999, opportunity +0.84) and Ashland/Huntington (0.999) lead. Knoxville, Roanoke, Louisville and Cincinnati fill out the run. Atlanta and Chicago are left alone, and route check found no radius conflicts. Her crowd skews 30–34 (+0.61) and away from under-25s (-0.29), so 21+ bar rooms and mid-size halls fit.

stops.why: Affinity 0.981, rank 0.969, 921k people. The biggest market on the run, an easy first leg (3.7 hours from Nashville), and 145 km from Cincinnati, so no clause conflict.

venue.name: Headliners Music Hall
venue.why: Venue affinity 0.848. It's also a top hangout for her fans in Louisville (0.887) and the right size for her draw.

openers.name: Kelsey Waldon
openers.why: Affinity 0.975 in Louisville, and she's a Kentucky native.

openers.name: Jeremy Pinnell
openers.why: Affinity 0.968 here, popularity 0.464. Cheap, fits the crowd.

promo.angle: Bourbon and honky-tonk. Do a whiskey-row tie-in.
promo.copy: Louisville, kicking off the run at Headliners with Kelsey Waldon. Bourbon's on you, songs are on me.

stops.why: Affinity 0.980, rank 0.968, opportunity +0.18 on 578k people. Only 2.1 hours from Louisville and 2.6 hours to Ashland.

venue.name: Northside Tavern
venue.why: Venue affinity 0.916, the second-best room match on the run.

openers.name: Jeremy Pinnell
openers.why: Affinity 0.974 in Cincinnati. Local to the area.

openers.name: Arlo McKinley
openers.why: Affinity 0.978 here, and he's a Cincinnati songwriter.

promo.angle: Northside and Northern Kentucky crowd. Cross-promote with the river-town bars.
promo.copy: Cincinnati, Northside Tavern, one night only. Jeremy Pinnell's opening. Get there early.

stops.why: Affinity 0.999, rank 0.988, opportunity +0.33 across a 358k tri-state metro (Ashland/Huntington). Eastern Kentucky and West Virginia is her home turf on paper.

venue.name: Sharkey's
venue.why: The only music venue the tool matched (affinity 0.789, in Huntington, WV). Its popularity is very low (0.017), so confirm the capacity before pitching.

openers.name: Arlo McKinley
openers.why: Affinity 0.983 here, the highest opener score on the whole run.

openers.name: Charles Wesley Godwin
openers.why: Affinity 0.972, and he's a West Virginia Appalachian country act. Local draw.

promo.angle: West Virginia roots. Lean on the regional crowd and the Huntington bar strip.
partners: Cocaine & Rhinestones: The History of Country Music
promo.copy: Tri-state, this one's close to home. Bringing the band to Huntington with Arlo McKinley. Y'all come on out.

stops.why: Affinity 0.974, rank 0.965, opportunity +0.54 on 150k people. A mid-size town that punches well above its size. It also breaks up the drive between Kentucky and North Carolina.

venue.name: The Spot on Kirk
venue.why: Venue affinity 0.856. It's also a top local hangout for her fans (0.900), in a downtown arts space.

openers.name: Town Mountain
openers.why: Affinity 0.958 in Roanoke. Bluegrass band with a Blue Ridge crowd.

promo.angle: Blue Ridge Parkway crowd. Do the after-party or pre-show at a local brewery.
promo.copy: Roanoke, first time playing for you. The Spot on Kirk, small room, big night. Town Mountain's coming too.

stops.why: Top of the heatmap. Affinity 0.999, affinity rank 0.989, opportunity +0.84 on a 95k population. Few towns this size are this into her.

venue.name: The Orange Peel
venue.why: Venue affinity 0.862, popularity 0.999. It's the room touring Americana acts play in Asheville, and it's walkable from downtown.

openers.name: Sarah Shook & the Disarmers
openers.why: Affinity 0.967 in Asheville. Rougher edge that sets up her set well.

openers.name: Joshua Hedley
openers.why: Affinity 0.966 here, popularity 0.517. Classic country, cheap add.

promo.angle: Mountain-town homecoming feel. Partner with Jack of the Wood Pub (0.914) for a pre-show pickin' session.
partners: Cocaine & Rhinestones: The History of Country Music
promo.copy: Asheville, I've been wanting to bring the whole band up the mountain for a long time. Orange Peel, one night. Come early and come dancing.

stops.why: Affinity 0.988, rank 0.973, opportunity +0.44 on 241k people. Only 1.9 hours from Asheville and clear of the radius clause (130 km).

venue.name: Boyd’s Jig and Reel
venue.why: Highest-matched venue on the whole run (affinity 0.918). It's a downtown Irish pub stage with a crowd that fits her.

openers.name: Hailey Whitters
openers.why: Affinity 0.967 in Knoxville. Storytelling songwriter who fits her crowd.

promo.angle: Market Square night out. Cross-promote with the bars her fans already use.
promo.copy: Knoxville, we're playing Boyd's Jig and Reel with Hailey Whitters. Bring your dancing shoes. It's gonna be a fiddle kind of night.

skipped.reason: Affinity 0.991 and opportunity +0.94, but it's about 80 km from Asheville, so it breaks the 120 km radius clause. Venue matches were weak too (two bar/restaurant rooms). Use it if Asheville falls through.
Affinity 0.988, but it's about 115–120 km from both Louisville and Cincinnati, so a radius clause would cost us one of them. It's a good swap if Louisville or Cincinnati won't hold a date.
Affinity 0.968 is below every stop on the run, and it adds a long leg. Save it for a Northeast run.
Home base. Affinity 0.997, but leave it out of a run that starts there. Book it as its own hometown show.

skipped.city: Santa Fe, NM / Missoula, MT / Bend, OR
skipped.reason: Opportunity scores of +0.74 to +0.92, but they're 1,700–3,000 km out. Better for a West run.

risks: Ashland/Huntington only matched one music venue, Sharkey's, with popularity 0.017. Capacity and production are unknown. Confirm before offering, or pitch Paramount Arts Center (a fan hangout at 0.865, but not flagged as a music venue match).

Lukas Nelson & Promise of the Real shows up everywhere but is close to her popularity (0.84 vs 0.914), so I left them off. Opener fees could still run high for Ruston Kelly or Parker McCollum if you swap them in.
Arlo McKinley and Kelsey Waldon are each down for two dates. If you want different openers in each city, use John R. Miller (0.967–0.981 across all six cities) as the swap.
Early-April dates in mountain towns can hit spring weather on the Ashland–Roanoke–Asheville legs.
